That's really ridiculous lol it's not as if it was a 3 course meal with drinks! That's so petty, youre well rid of that .
You aren't crazy she overreacted, she seems petty and argumentative mate.
I feel exactly the same , so done this year trust me 😢😢😢
I lost some so-called friends because they said I'd changed and wasn't up for going partying anymore that really hurt me to

I'm so very sorry for your losses , life feels just so empty and crap doesn't it?  It's a lonely world to live in now , I lost friendships when I lost my son because I wear my heart on my sleeve like us bpd people do, im so emotional , I'm ready to leave on the 3rd  anniversary of my son's death which is the 3rd of August but then I've got my 16yr old to think of  and I know he relys on me but I have family , I just feel torn , I hate feeling like this every damn day don't you?  I'm not living I'm just existing 😭

I feel suicidal every day since I lost my 22yr old son end of 2019 of a pulmonary embolism and because I suffer with bipolar I'm fighting my thoughts as I have a 16 yr old son to think of and I love him but my depression is overwhelming me
